submit_reasoning: The price history shows a stock that rose from ~30.34 to a peak of ~34.83 around bar 57, then declined back to ~31.02 by the end. Series stats: mean 32.56, std 1.30, CV ~4%. Seasonality detection found a 7-bar period but with zero strength (frequency default). Anomaly detection flagged 8 bars but nothing extreme at the tail. Both the history-only and event-informed forecasts selected the seasonal_naive model; all three context events extracted from the article (Zacks Rank Hold, bullish ABR, unchanged earnings estimate) were rejected by the ablation gate, so the event-informed run fell back to the same history-only trajectory. The forecast is a 7-bar repeating seasonal pattern anchored to recent prices, which is reasonable given the lack of strong seasonality and the neutral-to-cautious article sentiment. Support is degraded due to limited evaluation folds, but the forecast is the best available.
